title: Library
disclaimer: Unofficial fan and editorial reading list. Not affiliated with any league, club, or school. Book, article, and podcast links leave this site. Titles were checked against publisher pages, official team media, and major outlets — nothing invented to fill a slot.

books.title: 100 Things Seahawks Fans Should Know & Do Before They Die
books.author: John Morgan
books.blurb: Triumph’s franchise checklist: lore, Super Bowl XLVIII, Pete Carroll, and 12s culture. Updated from the 2010 first edition.

books.title: Tales from the Seattle Seahawks Sideline
books.author: Steve Raible with Mike Sando
books.blurb: Revised locker-room and broadcast-booth stories from the original wideout and longtime KIRO voice, covering Largent through the Holmgren years.

books.title: Win Forever: Live, Work, and Play Like a Champion
books.author: Pete Carroll with Yogi Roth and Kristoffer A. Garin
books.blurb: Carroll’s “always compete” philosophy. The Portfolio paperback adds a chapter on his first Seahawks season after the 2010 hardcover.

articles.title: Seahawks dominate Denver from start to finish to win Super Bowl
At long last, the Lombardi Trophy is coming to Seattle
‘I don’t think there’s any trust’: The irreconcilable differences of Russell Wilson, Seahawks

podcasts.note: Official club show: weekly game breakdowns from the sideline reporter and the team’s senior digital reporter.
Daily independent beat-and-draft show in the Locked On network.

books.title: Tales from the Seattle Mariners Dugout
books.author: Kirby Arnold
books.blurb: Revised dugout history from the 1970s losses through Griffey, Unit, Edgar, and the 1995 “Refuse to Lose” rise. Arnold covered the club for The Herald.

books.title: 100 Things Mariners Fans Should Know & Do Before They Die
books.author: Michael Emmerich
books.blurb: King’s Court, Felix’s perfect game, the 116-win 2001 club, two Griffeys, and the Pilots footnote.

books.title: Pitchers of Beer: The Story of the Seattle Rainiers
books.author: Dan Raley
books.blurb: University of Nebraska Press history of Seattle’s PCL club (1937–1964) — the civic baseball story before the Mariners arrived in 1977.

articles.title: Ichiro becomes third Mariners legend to enter Baseball Hall of Fame
October 6, 2001: Seattle Mariners catch the 1906 Cubs with record-tying 116th win
Mariners open ‘Legacy Plaza’ featuring statue of iconic 2001 American flag moment

podcasts.note: Official club feed: highlights, interviews, and MLB.com extras.

podcasts.hosts: Ty Dane Gonzalez and Colby Patnode
podcasts.note: Daily independent Mariners show in the Locked On network.

collections.coverageNote: The club is young (2021). One substantial origin book, plus expansion reporting and official audio — not a deep bookshelf yet.

books.title: Rising From the Deep: The Seattle Kraken, a Tenacious Push for Expansion, and the Emerald City’s Sports Revival
books.author: Geoff Baker
books.blurb: Seattle Times hockey reporter on how NHL Seattle was built after the Sonics left, from Metropolitans history to Climate Pledge Arena.

articles.title: Seattle approved as 32nd NHL franchise, to start play in 2021-22
‘Dream of Seattle and the NHL comes true’ as Kraken pays off expansion fee and officially joins league

podcasts.note: Official Kraken podcast: interviews, analysis, and road dispatches.
Daily independent Kraken show in the Locked On network.

books.title: 100 Things Sounders Fans Should Know & Do Before They Die
books.author: Geoff Baker
books.blurb: USL roots through the 2016 MLS Cup run, tifo culture, and Dempsey / Lodeiro-era nights. Baker then covered the club for The Seattle Times.

books.title: The Sound and the Glory: How the Seattle Sounders Showed Major League Soccer How to Win Over America
books.author: Matt Pentz
books.blurb: ECW Press narrative of the 2016 title — crowds, egos, and the first MLS Cup — by the Times beat writer who covered that run.

articles.title: First impressions: Sounders win first MLS Cup title in penalty-kick shootout
Complete coverage: Sounders take down Toronto FC in PK’s to capture first MLS Cup title

podcasts.hosts: Jeremiah Oshan and Sounder at Heart
podcasts.note: Long-running independent Sounders podcast from the SB Nation club site.
KJR FM club-week show plus full-match and postgame audio.

books.title: Game On!: How Women’s Basketball Took Seattle by Storm
books.author: Jayda Evans
books.blurb: Early Storm history from the Times beat writer, through Lin Dunn, Lauren Jackson, and Betty Lennox in the league’s first Seattle decade.

books.title: My Story
books.author: Lauren Jackson
books.blurb: Allen & Unwin memoir of the Australian star’s career, including 12 Storm seasons and the first foreign WNBA MVP.

books.title: The Heart of the Storm: A Biography of Sue Bird
books.author: Sharon Mentyka, illustrated by Ellen Rooney
books.blurb: Sasquatch / Little Bigfoot picture-book biography of Bird’s path from UConn to four Storm titles. Written for ages 5–9.

articles.title: CHAMPS! Seattle Storm completes sweep of Aces to capture fourth WNBA title
‘Thank you, Sue’ crowd chants as Sue Bird’s career ends with Storm playoff loss

podcasts.hosts: Erica L. Ayala and Roberta Rodrigues
podcasts.note: Independent Storm show from Black Rosie Media — recaps and roster talk, not a club production.

collections.coverageNote: Few club-specific books. Rapinoe’s memoir is the main long-form title; the rest is Times reporting and KJR’s Reign Weekly.

books.title: One Life
books.author: Megan Rapinoe with Emma Brockes
books.blurb: Penguin Press memoir from the Reign and USWNT star — coming out, kneeling, equal pay, and Seattle years. Instant New York Times bestseller.

articles.title: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe talks about her new memoir ‘One Life,’ activism, pay equity and more
Megan Rapinoe getting retirement celebration fit for a Seattle sports legend

podcasts.note: KJR FM weekly Reign recap and interviews, bundled with Sounders audio on the same feed.

collections.coverageNote: Football, basketball, and crew share this list. Rowing is not on the ticket calendar, but The Boys in the Boat is the best-known UW sports book.

books.title: The Boys in the Boat: Nine Americans and Their Epic Quest for Gold at the 1936 Berlin Olympics
books.author: Daniel James Brown
books.blurb: Viking narrative of the UW eight that won Olympic gold in Berlin, centered on Joe Rantz, Al Ulbrickson, and George Pocock.

books.title: 100 Things Washington Fans Should Know & Do Before They Die
books.author: Adam Jude, foreword by Damon Huard
books.blurb: Times Huskies beat writer on 1991, Quarterback U, Don James through Chris Petersen, and basketball notes including Kelsey Plum.

books.title: Sonny Sixkiller’s Tales from the Huskies Sideline
books.author: Sonny Sixkiller and Bob Condotta
books.blurb: Former UW quarterback on Rose Bowls, Don James, Warren Moon, and the 1991 title season.

articles.title: Throwback Thursday: Washington posts undefeated championship season in 1991
New book tells stirring story of UW crew winning Olympic gold

podcasts.note: Daily independent football and basketball show in the Locked On network.

collections.coverageNote: PWHL Seattle is new. No book-length club histories yet. Name-reveal reporting only — no dedicated Torrent podcast found.

collections.coverageNote: Thin shelf. The main long-form title is Elgin Baylor’s memoir (Seattle U, then the Lakers). No Redhawks-specific podcast found.

books.title: Hang Time: My Life in Basketball
books.author: Elgin Baylor with Alan Eisenstock
books.blurb: Houghton Mifflin Harcourt / Mariner autobiography. Baylor led Seattle University to the 1958 NCAA title game before the Minneapolis/L.A. Lakers.
